COLDWAR_VIE_apply_state_root = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_root_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_state_political_power_factor = 0.04 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_political_power_factor }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_state_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_political_dialogue
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_root_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_root_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_root_pending }
	}
}

				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_stage < 1 }
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_0
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_1
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_2
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_1
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_stage = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_assembly_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_assembly_pending

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_state_charter = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_charter_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_state_religion_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_religion_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_state_stability_factor = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_stability_factor }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_state_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_stage < 2 }
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_0
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_1
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_2
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_2
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_cadre_state_stage = 2 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_charter_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_charter_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_charter_pending }
	}
}

				emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes
				has_country_leader = { name = "Truong Chinh" ruling_only = yes }
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_02_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.02 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_evidence_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_evidence_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_programme }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0.04
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_agricolture_productivity_modifier
			}
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.02 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_local_pilot
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_field_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_field_pending

					}
				}

				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_country_productivity_growth_modifier
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_linh_stability_factor = -0.06 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_stability_factor }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_price_stabilisation
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_prices days = 270 }

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_front_welfare = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_front_welfare_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				has_government = neutrality
				neutrality_neutral_communism_are_in_power = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_04_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.04 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_front_cooperative_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_front_cooperative_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_front_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_front_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_front_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_front_stability_factor = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_stability_factor }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_front_social_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.03 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_social_cost_multiplier_modifier }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.04 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_front_welfare_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_front_welfare_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_front_welfare_pending }
	}

			limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes has_government = democratic western_liberals_are_in_power = yes }

					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_dem_research_speed_factor = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_research_speed_factor }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_dem_political_power_factor = -0.04 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_political_power_factor }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_constitutional_convention
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_small_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				has_government = democratic
				western_liberals_are_in_power = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_025_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_tender_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_tender_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_programme }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_dem_country_productivity_growth_modifier = 0.05
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_country_productivity_growth_modifier
			}
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_dem_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.015
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.025 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_small_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_small_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_dem_small_pending }

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_intellect_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				has_government = democratic
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_03_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.03 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_bargain_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_bargain_reward_applied }
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_arbitrate_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_arbitrate_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_soc_research_speed_factor = 0.035 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_research_speed_factor }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_soc_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.045
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_education_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.03 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_intellect_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_intellect_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_soc_intellect_pending }
	}

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_nat_arsenal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_nat_arsenal_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				has_government = democratic
				western_autocrats_are_in_power = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_12_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.12 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				524 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
					free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = no }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_nat_protection_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_nat_protection_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.12 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			524 = {
				add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = no }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_nat_arsenal_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_nat_arsenal_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_nat_arsenal_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_junta_depot = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_depot_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				has_government = nationalist
				nationalist_military_junta_are_in_power = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_12_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.12 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				524 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
					free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = no }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_defence_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_defence_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.12 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			524 = {
				add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = no }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_depot_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_depot_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_depot_pending }
	}
}

					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_relief_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_relief_reward_applied }

					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_programme }
			}

				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_project_audit
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_junta_audit_pending
		}

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_industry_root = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_root_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_programme }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_industry_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_reconstruction
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_war_damage_stage < 1 }
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_war_damage_0
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_war_damage_1
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_war_damage_2
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_war_damage_3
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_war_damage_1
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_war_damage_stage = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_root_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_root_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_root_pending }
	}

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_industry_repair = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_repair_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_025_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_disperse_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_disperse_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_programme }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_industry_production_speed_infrastructure_factor = 0.06
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_production_speed_infrastructure_factor
			}
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_industry_agricolture_productivity_modifier = -0.02
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_agricolture_productivity_modifier
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.025 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_repair_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_repair_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_repair_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_VIE_apply_industry_power = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_power_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_1_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				522 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
					free_building_slots = { building = fossil_powerplant size > 0 }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_concentrate_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_concentrate_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			522 = {
				add_building_construction = { type = fossil_powerplant level = 1 instant_build = no }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_power_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_power_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_power_pending }
	}
}

				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_capital_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_capital_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.12 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			524 = {
				add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = no }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_machine_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_machine_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_industry_machine_pending }
	}

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_farm_district = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_district_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_055_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.055 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				523 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
					free_building_slots = { building = agriculture_district size > 0 include_locked = no }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_inputs_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_inputs_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.055 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			523 = {
				add_building_construction = { type = agriculture_district level = 1 instant_build = no }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_district_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_district_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_district_pending }

						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_distribution_reward_applied
					}
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_surplus_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_surplus_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_programme }
			}

				COLDWAR_VIE_farm_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0.03
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_agricolture_productivity_modifier
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_farm_social_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_social_cost_multiplier_modifier }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_rationing_stage < 2 }
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_rationing_0
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_rationing_1
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_rationing_2
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_rationing_2
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_rationing_stage = 2 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_security_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_security_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_farm_security_pending }

COLDWAR_VIE_apply_army_airdefence = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_army_airdefence_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_06_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.06 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				522 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
					free_building_slots = { building = anti_air_building size > 0 }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_army_supply_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_army_supply_reward_applied }
					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_army_staff_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_army_staff_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.06 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			522 = {
				add_building_construction = { type = anti_air_building level = 1 instant_build = no }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_army_airdefence_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_army_airdefence_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_army_airdefence_pending }
	}

					custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_unity_resettle_reward_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unity_resettle_reward_applied }
				}
			}
			if = {

					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_unity_programme }

				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_country_productivity_growth_modifier
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_unity_war_support_factor = -0.03 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_war_support_factor }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_division_stage < 1 }
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_division_0
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_division_1
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_division_1
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_division_stage = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unity_peace_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unity_peace_pending

			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_025_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_moscow_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_moscow_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_research_speed_factor = 0.03 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_research_speed_factor }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.025 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_technical_assistance
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_specialists_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_specialists_pending
		}

	}

		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_border_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_border_reward_applied
					}
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_confidence_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_confidence_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_imp_sanction_resistance = 0.04 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_imp_sanction_resistance }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_sanctions_dialogue
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_stage < 1 }
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_0
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_1
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_2
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_1
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_stage = 1 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_isolation_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_isolation_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_isolation_pending }
	}
}

						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_opening_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_research_speed_factor = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_research_speed_factor }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_political_power_factor = -0.03 tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_political_power_factor }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_normalisation_offer
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_normalise_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_normalise_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_normalise_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_VIE_apply_diplomacy_transition = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_transition_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				OR = {
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_alternatives_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_alternatives_reward_applied
					}
					custom_trigger_tooltip = {
						tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_normalise_reward_applied
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_normalise_reward_applied
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_programme }
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_country_productivity_growth_modifier = 0.03
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_country_productivity_growth_modifier
			}
			add_to_variable = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.015
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_tt_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_unlock_patron_transition
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_stage < 2 }
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_0
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_1
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_2
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_2
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_VIE_patrons_stage = 2 }
			}
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_transition_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_transition_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_diplomacy_transition_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_VIE_sync_programmes = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_state_root_reward_applied }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_state_programme }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes
				has_country_leader = { name = "Le Duan" ruling_only = yes }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_duan_root_reward_applied
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_duan_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_duan_programme }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_duan_programme }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_duan_programme }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes
				has_country_leader = { name = "Truong Chinh" ruling_only = yes }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_root_reward_applied
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_programme }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_programme }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_chinh_programme }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes
				has_country_leader = { name = "Nguyen Van Linh" ruling_only = yes }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_linh_root_reward_applied
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_linh_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_linh_programme }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_linh_programme }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_linh_programme }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes
				has_country_leader = { name = "Vo Van Kiet" ruling_only = yes }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_kiet_root_reward_applied
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_kiet_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_kiet_programme }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_kiet_programme }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_VIE_kiet_programme }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes
				has_government = neutrality
				neutrality_neutral_communism_are_in_power = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_front_root_reward_applied
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {

COLDWAR_VIE_decision_rice_import_implement = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_VIE_decision_rice_import_eligible = yes
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_035_tt
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.035 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_rice_import_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_ration_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_farm_contract_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_local_pilot_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_price_cushion_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_enterprise_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_transport_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_renovation_idea }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_southern_recovery_idea }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.035 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_rice_import_idea days = 180 }
	}
}

			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_border_trade_idea }
			tag = VIE
			USA = { exists = yes }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_sanctions_offer_pending
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.015 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_sanctions_idea days = 270 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_sanctions_offer_pending
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_decision_sanctions_awaiting_response
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_VIE_DIP.140 days = 1 }

}

COLDWAR_VIE_daily_update = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
		COLDWAR_VIE_initialize = yes
		COLDWAR_VIE_1970_update_politics = yes
		COLDWAR_VIE_sync_programmes = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				date > 1971.8.19
				date < 1971.11.1
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_flood_seen }
				522 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = VIE }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_flood_seen
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_VIE_CRISIS.1 days = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_war_with = CHI
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_border }
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_border days = 180 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_war_with = CHI }
				has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_border
			}
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_border
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_watch_SOV
				OR = {
					NOT = { COLDWAR_VIE_cooperation_SOV = yes }
					SOV = { exists = no }
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_communist_patron_SOV
						SOV = {
							NOT = { has_government = communism }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_watch_SOV
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_communist_patron_SOV
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_patron }
				}
				add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_patron days = 270 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_VIE_CRISIS.2 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_watch_CHI
				OR = {
					NOT = { COLDWAR_VIE_cooperation_CHI = yes }
					CHI = { exists = no }
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_communist_patron_CHI
						CHI = {
							NOT = { has_government = communism }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_watch_CHI
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_communist_patron_CHI
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_VIE_crisis_patron }
				}
